description: This file contains utility functions for handling images and files within a chat-based AI system, including uploading, processing, replacing, and extracting artifacts, as well as managing message content and flow state updates.

methods.name: addImagesToMessages
methods.description: Converts image uploads into message content with base64 URLs or URLs, preparing images for chat messages.

methods.name: processMessagesWithImages
methods.description: Replaces stored-file references in messages with base64 image data for display.

methods.name: replaceBase64ImagesWithFileReferences
methods.description: Replaces base64 image data in messages with file references, managing previous and new images.

methods.name: getUniqueImageMessages
methods.description: Generates unique image messages from uploads, avoiding duplicates with previous messages.

methods.name: getPastChatHistoryImageMessages
methods.description: Processes past chat history to extract and convert image messages, including file retrieval.

methods.name: getMimeTypeFromFilename
methods.description: Determines MIME type based on filename extension.

methods.name: getArtifactTypeFromFilename
methods.description: Determines artifact type for UI rendering based on filename extension.

methods.name: saveBase64Image
methods.description: Saves base64-encoded image data to storage and returns file info.

methods.name: saveGeminiInlineImage
methods.description: Saves Gemini inline image data to storage and returns file info.

methods.name: downloadContainerFile
methods.description: Downloads file content from a container file citation and stores it.

methods.name: replaceInlineDataWithFileReferences
methods.description: Replaces inline base64 data in message chunks with file references.

methods.name: extractArtifactsFromResponse
methods.description: Extracts artifacts and annotations from response metadata, including container files and generated images.

methods.name: addImageArtifactsToMessages
methods.description: Adds previous assistant image artifacts as user messages for reference.

methods.name: updateFlowState
methods.description: Updates the flow state object with new key-value pairs.
